phases.start: host request before transport; attempt 0; no raw request payload
phases.send: after send callback returns; actual assigned sequence, not RF or firmware acceptance
phases.response: candidate before destructive parser; sample groups header and spans
phases.parse: host parser return; -EAGAIN remains mismatch; never success inferred from response pre-parse
phases.done: final host operation return; can be no-wait, pre-send failure, timeout or parser result
phases.async: unsolicited header and safe spans; cmd/cookie/attempt zero, expected_seq -1, no matching request inferred

sample: monotonic observation-local 64-bit counter; all byte spans from one callback share sample; scope by boot/device; parse is separate sample
cookie: monotonic core operation counter under MCU mutex; scope by boot/device; not identical to 0002 timestamp cookie
attempt: one-based actual send attempts; 0 before send; does not change existing retry limit
hex: compact lowercase %*phN bytes; empty when captured_len 0; never parse an omitted span as zero bytes
offset: from original received skb data before skb_pull; not payload-relative
region_len: number of original bytes described by safe or suppression record
captured_len: bytes retained; either region_len or zero; maximum 15 per safe span
unknown_numeric: -1; zero is a real value except explicitly reserved async cmd/cookie/attempt

async_allowlist.prefix: 44 byte rxd followed by 4 reserved bytes
async_allowlist.tlv_fields: tag le16, len le16, bss_idx, tokenid, status, primarychannel, rfsco, rfband, channelwidth, centerfreqseg1, centerfreqseg2, reqtype, dbdcband, reserved byte, max_interval le32

integration: Rawls/parent should validate safe allowlist, offset lengths, sample scope and header consistency before decoding. Never concatenate across samples or overwrite safe bytes with suppressed/unknown regions. A parse ret0 is not proof all requested link state became operational.
